data.long_meaning: Deepansha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Deep' meaning deep and 'Ansh' meaning meaning or symbol. This name signifies a deep meaning or a profound symbol. The name Deepansha carries the meaning “Deep + Ansh = Deep Meaning” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepansha usually hope their child will grow to embody deep + ansh = deep meaning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
